experiment_template.research_question: Does the same paging fix replicate across windows and variants?
stop_conditions: No source drift, retries, replacement rows or budget expansion.
Stop for review on first candidate failure; preserve incomplete cohort.

success_criteria.exposure_parameters: Prospective extrapolation from observed 8K pressure. No claim of prior 10K/12K calibration. No-exposure is a failed recovery endpoint.
success_criteria.threshold_rule: Every dispatched projected bound < configured soft limit -256

falsifier: Any candidate trial fails its semantic/schema checks, lacks actual recycling or archive recovery, has unknown delivery, or exceeds its measured dispatch threshold.
mechanism: Byte limits reduce each dense observation enough for measured admission; retained history can then recycle without losing required source or archive delivery.
scope: 24-row prospective replication, two ordered repetitions per variant/window; synthetic pressure, two variants of one family; not natural-task or broad GLM qualification.
statement: The same byte-bounded pager completes dense Unicode repairs with actual recycling and archive recovery across 8K, 10K and 12K and two archive repair variants.
